Convert gene sets between formats

Source: R/gene_sets.R
format_gene_sets.Rd

Converts gene sets between a GMT file, a named list of gene vectors (the input of fgsea and of Seurat::AddModuleScore()) and a GSEABase `GeneSetCollection`.

Usage

format_gene_sets(gsc, to = c("GeneSetCollection", "list", "gmt"), file = NULL)

Arguments

gsc

A GeneSetCollection object or a list of gene sets or a path to a GMT file.

to

A character string indicating the format to convert to. Available options are "GeneSetCollection", "list", and "gmt".

file

For `to = "gmt"`, a file to write the GMT lines to. Default is NULL (only returned)

Value

A GeneSetCollection object, a named list of gene sets, or, for "gmt", the GMT lines (one per set: name, an empty description, then the genes, separated by tabs), invisibly when written to `file`

Examples

sets <- list(SET_A = c("CD3E", "CD3D"), SET_B = c("MS4A1", "CD79A", "CD19"))
format_gene_sets(sets, to = "gmt")
#> [1] "SET_A\t\tCD3E\tCD3D"         "SET_B\t\tMS4A1\tCD79A\tCD19"
